overview_description.description: NewCraft is a data warehouse for employee data.  We connect to products like Rippling, Greenhouse, Lattice and more to make all of your employee data accessible with a simple API.  You can think of us like Segment for employee data.  NewCraft makes it 10x easier to add a new employee service or migrate between these services.
